API_FACTS.lateinit: PASS: var only; non-null non-primitive types; class property cannot have custom accessors or be a primary-constructor property; read-before-assignment throws UninitializedPropertyAccessException. Assignment source may be in-class, external, or DI.
API_FACTS.lazy_and_delegate: PASS: lazy(initializer) returns Lazy<T>; standard delegated property is val because Lazy exposes getValue but no setValue. A var may hold a Lazy object without making a property delegated by it settable.
API_FACTS.cache_retry: PASS: successful initializer result retained; throw triggers retry on next access.
API_FACTS.state_checks: PASS: Lazy.isInitialized() queries the Lazy instance; lateinit ::property.isInitialized is restricted by property-reference access scope. Example checks inside declaring class.
API_FACTS.JVM_modes: PASS: default SYNCHRONIZED; PUBLICATION permits concurrent initializer calls but publishes a single used value; NONE has no thread-safety guarantees and multiple-thread behavior is unspecified. Synchronization of initialization does not make returned mutable object thread-safe.
